title.zh: 多镜头故事视频成对比较
title.en: Pairwise Comparison of Multi-shot Story Videos

intro.zh: 每道题给出一段故事梗概和两个根据同一故事生成的多镜头视频（视频 A 与视频 B）。请比较两个视频，回答四个问题。
intro.en: Each item shows a short story synopsis and two multi-shot videos generated for the same story (Video A and Video B). Please compare the two videos and answer four questions.

zh: 生成视频的系统名称已隐藏，左右位置随机。
请先完整观看两个视频（每个至少看完 90%），再作答。可以用“同时从头播放”按钮一起看，也可以分开看、反复看。
视频不含声音。只根据画面判断即可。
如果两个视频确实难分高下，或者看起来一样，请选“差不多”。
每组约 7 题，每题约 3–4 分钟。做完一组可以继续下一组，也可以下次再来：使用同一个评测 ID 会接着之前的进度，不会重复出题。
en: The names of the systems are hidden and the left/right positions are randomized.
Please watch both videos (at least 90% of each) before answering. You can play them together with “Play both from start”, or watch them separately and replay them.
The videos have no sound. Judge from the pictures only.
If the two videos are genuinely equal, or look the same, choose “About the same”.
A batch has about 7 items of 3–4 minutes each. After a batch you may continue or come back later; the same evaluator ID resumes your progress without repeating items.

consent.zh: 我自愿参与本次评测。我的作答以匿名编号保存，只用于学术研究中的汇总统计；我可以随时停止。
consent.en: I take part voluntarily. My answers are stored under an anonymous code and used only for aggregate analysis in academic research. I may stop at any time.

question.zh: 哪个视频让你更容易看懂这个故事（发生了什么、按什么顺序发生）？
question.en: Which video makes the story easier to follow (what happens and in what order)?

question.zh: 哪个视频中的关键动作和事件表现得更清楚？
question.en: In which video are the key actions and events shown more clearly?

question.zh: 哪个视频中的人物、物品和场景在不同镜头之间保持得更一致？
question.en: In which video do characters, objects, and places stay more consistent across shots?

question.zh: 综合来看，你更喜欢哪个视频？
question.en: Overall, which video do you prefer?

text.zh: 一名学生在教室拿起书包，到储物间把书包放进储物柜。她发现笔记本落在了教室的课桌上，于是回教室取回笔记本，再回到储物间把笔记本放进书包。
text.en: A student picks up her backpack in the classroom and stores it in a locker. Realizing she left her notebook on the classroom desk, she goes back for it, then returns to the locker room and puts the notebook into her backpack.

text.zh: 一位画家在沙漠、暴风雨中的海岸和雪地等不同场景中作画。
text.en: A painter works on a painting in different places: a desert, a stormy coast, and a snowy landscape.

text.zh: 一位厨师在不断变换的场景中制作同一道菜。
text.en: A chef prepares the same dish while the setting keeps changing.
